name: Manulife Bank Visa Infinite Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee waived in the first year.

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances and balance transfers.

credit_required.notes: Minimum individual income of $60,000 or household income of $100,000.

base_rate.description: 1% rewards on everyday essentials and all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: You can redeem your rewards anytime towards an eligible purchase or statement credit as long as the account is in good standing.

signup_bonus.description: 10% rewards on eligible purchases for the first 3 statements.

notes: Applications are open to existing Manulife Bank customers through online banking; the page says new customers will be welcomed soon. Earn rates are percent rewards paid as Manulife Better Rewards points (1% equals 1 point per $1). Additional cardholder fee is $50. Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name.
